The '''Koradin sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Koradin [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was first mentioned in the [[1994]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]'', authored by [[Rick D. Stuart]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG11">''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]''</ref> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] placed the [[Brint-wo system/Legends|Brint-wo]] and [[Tegrat system/Legends|Tegrat systems]] in the sector.<ref name="EAOC" />

The latter contained<ref name="EAOC" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tegrat]], which appeared in the ''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'' adventure "[[Imperial Research Station 13 (article)|Imperial Research Station 13]]," written by [[Lester W. Smith]] and published in the [[October]]-[[November]] [[1990]] [[Challenge 46|forty-sixth issue]] of the [[Challenge (magazine)|''Challenge'']] magazine. The adventure was thereby established as the de facto earliest appearance of the Koradin sector; however, since it was released outside of the [[Lucas Licensing]] process, its [[canon]]icity with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity was never confirmed.<ref name="Challenge">{{ChallengeCite|46|Imperial Research Station 13 (article)}}</ref> Therefore the appearance of the planet [[Brint-wo]] and the [[Golan Space Colony 3|space station]] [[Brint-wo Colony]] in the [[1999]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'' serves as the first undisputedly canonical Legends appearance of the Koradin sector.<ref name="XWA">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref>
